newsitem.title: FRANCE: French industrial activity seen rising -BoF survey.
newsitem.headline: French industrial activity seen rising -BoF survey.

text.p: French industrial activity should continue to pick up in the coming months, but a drop is expected in the car industry, the Bank of France said in a statement on Thursday on its April survey of industrialists.
"According to business leaders surveyed, industrial output made significant progress in April. Output increased across the board particularly in the intermediate goods sector," it said.
"Activity should continue to grow in the coming months, except in the automobile industry, where a downturn is expected," it said.
"Business leaders continued to view investment plans with caution. They still give priority to the modernisation of equipment, which is generally self-financed," it said.
"Employment levels varied little in industry, except for further contraction in the automoble sector. They remained stable in the building, retail and market services sector," it said.
"Business leaders met the upturn in activity by encouraging flexible working-hour agreements and resorting more to temporary staff," the statement added.
